subject: Magic Mirror
text: The Magic Mirror is in a chest in the Ice Pyramid.

evidence.quote: I picked up the magic mirror from the chest in the Ice Pyramid and it didn't pop.

subject: Narcissus
text: After continuing, the achievement popped only when the save file was loaded later.

evidence.quote: I decided to go on anyways, and when I went to load up the save file later it popped.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: The Magic Mirror should not be picked up before the Ice Golem fight, to get the other achievement.

evidence.quote: This should be lower on the list, considering you shouldn't pick it up before the ice golem fight (to get the other achievement).

subject: Magic Mirror
text: A player went back for the mirror after the boss challenge and missed one encounter.

evidence.quote: got the boss challenge then went back to pick it up only to have missed 1 encounter so oops

subject: Magic Mirror chest
text: The Magic Mirror chest counts toward Fridge Raider and must be reopened after the boss if the dungeon is cleared without the mirror.

evidence.quote: Just FYI, this includes the chest with the Magic Mirror. So, if you're doing the Achievement to beat the dungeon without it, you have to loop back to pick it up after you beat the boss.

subject: optional treasure chests
text: Optional chests must be looted, not just opened; if already at max bombs, enter a fight and throw a bomb to open the chest.

evidence.quote: you need to collect the loot from the chests, not just open them. If you already have max arrows or bombs get into a fight and attack or just throw out a bomb to be able to open it.

subject: ally
text: Set the ally to manual control so she does not waste the fire spell on regular encounters, saving it for the boss.

evidence.quote: set your ally to manual control so she doesn't waste the fire spell on regular encounters, as you'll want those for the boss

subject: final optional treasure chest
text: The final optional treasure chest, holding the Magic Mirror, is collected only after beating the boss.

evidence.quote: which you have to beat before collecting the final optional treasure chest with the magic mirror inside

subject: optional treasure chests
text: Leaving the dungeon resets most optional treasure chests.

evidence.quote: If you leave, most of the optional treasure chests reset.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: Picking up the Magic Mirror prevents this achievement from popping.

evidence.quote: Ok this isnt written anywhere, but apparently you cant even pick up the mirror or this won't pop.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: A player picked up the mirror expecting to choose not to use it and made a backup save just in case.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I also picked it up thinking I could choose not to use it... thankfully I made a back up save just in case.

subject: Magic Mirror
text: A player missed the Magic Mirror and got this achievement very easily.

evidence.quote: missed the mirror in my run so got this one very easily

subject: red chest on the first floor
text: Leave the red chest on the first floor to the right of the entrance unopened; it can be opened after the boss.

evidence.quote: just don't open the red chest on the first floor to the right of the entrance, and you're good to go. You can come back and get it after the boss.
